title: helianthemum lavandulifolium var. stoechadifolium
intro: Helianthemum lavandulifolium var. stoechadifolium, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and other stress-related disorders due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids. These constituents work synergistically to provide relaxation, reduce inflammation, and promote overall well-being.
